summary: Audit of phase_base 562c5800..audited_head a12329d9, focused on the remediation diff 128b6c12..a12329d9 (Red 96a581a0, Green e68b4b4f, plan 8a567fb9 and a12329d9). HEAD equals a12329d9. GREEN_TEST_COMMAND at HEAD gives Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 70 passed (70), which matches the plan claim (N_new 29 + N_old 41 = 70, strict it( line counts). The three fixes are real and each has a non-vacuous test: F1 restart scan skips the cards child (CG12), F2 classifyOutDir resolves paths and refuses unknown folders before readKey (CG13, including a CLI probe), F3 runGuards projects the pool and the CLI re-checks before each pool item (CG14). The restart path still classifies week, cover, elements and default outDirs as restart, and the notice line now reads guards.reportAt (RA-1 fixed), and the fan spec says blue handle (RA-5 fixed). Two Major findings remain. First, outDir <unit>/cards/muse/elements classifies as restart while no scan reads it after the cards skip, so a 5.00 USD row there is invisible (probe: refused false, run restart, spend 0). Second, spec.md still states the opposite scan behavior. The color-pool cushion is a conservative reading of the routed F3 rule: it refuses a superset and never allows what the rule forbids, so CG4 boundaries hold.

No test covers this path: CG13 allows only `w04/muse/elements`. Disposition: note; fix by refusing or classifying the card elements folder as `card`.

Disposition: note.

RA2-4 [Nit] scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:256-290,414-420: for cmd `line` one re-check precedes up to opts.tries concurrent provider calls, because doLine runs its tries in one Promise.all. RA2-5 [Nit] scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:414-420,433-436: a mid-pool refusal prints its message and returns, so main ends normally and the process exits 0. Only a pre-pool refusal exits 3. A caller that reads the exit code sees success for a run stopped at the cap. Disposition: note.

RA-5 fixed: docs/storytime/l2-unit1/cards/l2-w02-card-fan.json:10,14 now say a blue handle. The list row at tests/fixtures/storytime/pictures-v7.json:3004 matches.
F1 proof: CG12 runs in the gate. A restart call on a root with 0.50 USD week rows and 0.60 USD card rows gives run restart, refused false, spend 0.50. The card call on the same root gives spend 0.60.

F2 probe on the live module: classifyOutDir returns card for cards/muse, restart for cover/muse, w03/muse and w03/muse/elements, and invalid for cards/muse2 and the dot-dot escape. A spec without outDir resolves to out/storytime/l2/unit1/w01/muse.
F2 CLI proof: CG13 copies the two scripts to a temp repo and runs color on a bad outDir. It exits 3 and prints the outDir before any key read.

Restart path: all 17 distinct outDir values in docs/storytime classify as card (1) or restart (16). The default matches scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:27. The restart scan still reads week, cover and elements cost files.
RA2-1 probe on the live module: a 5.00 USD row in cards/muse/elements/costs.tsv gives runGuards refused=false, run=restart, spend=0. scanCostFiles reads 0 rows. scanCardCostFiles reads 1 row.
RA2-1 reachability: spec.md:192 names cards/muse/elements/costs.tsv as card spend. CG8 at tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts:126 writes that file. It is the only outDir that can create it.
RA2-1 regression: at 128b6c12 scanCostFiles had no skip, so the restart scan read that row and refused the call. The new skip and the new class rule combine to hide it.
RA2-2 check: spec.md:197-199 states the old scan behavior. test-strategy.md:48 states the same fact with a 7af682db date stamp, so it reads as a dated snapshot.
F3 projection: line pools use spend + calls x margin > cap, the routed rule. Color pools add one margin, so they refuse a superset of the rule.
F3 soundness: the color cushion never allows a call the routed rule forbids. CG4 boundaries 1.30, 1.58, 1.595 and 1.60 are spendGuard values and are unchanged.
F3 boundary shift: a single color call now needs spend at or below 1.58 USD, not 1.59. CG14 pins 1.58 as allowed and 1.595 as refused. The shift is on the safe side.

F3 cushion caveat: the comment at scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:252-254 justifies one margin by the line picture that follows each passing color, but N colors would follow with N lines. The line invocation gates itself, so no gap results.
Pool re-check: scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:414 calls runGuards before each pool item and returns without a call on refusal. It reads costs.tsv from disk each time, so spend cannot double count.

Callers: runGuards is called by scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:404 and :414 and by the two guard test files. classifyOutDir is called only by runGuards at guards:257. scanCostFiles is called only by runGuards at guards:289.
A4: each new test fails without its fix. The plan mutations MF1, MF2 and MF3 map to CG12, CG13 and CG14. No new check passes on a missing or absent deliverable.
A5: plan.md claims 6 files and 70 tests. My run gives the same labeled values. The arithmetic 29 + 41 = 70 is correct.
